Chapter 675 - 675 Success; No Trust!

Chapter 675 - 675 Success; No Trust!

675 Success; No Trust!

Inside the door was a boundless void passage.

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Xia Bing were like three colorful lights that flew forward.

At this moment, a ferocious golden dragon claw suddenly appeared in the void and shot toward the three of them.

Lin Fan raised his brows and hurriedly brought Xia Xue and Xia Bing to jump through space to dodge.

Space was unpredictable and had the magical power to isolate everything.

However, even though Lin Fan had entered the space, the golden dragon claw was still following closely behind him.

No!

Not only did it follow behind, but its speed also increased and entered Lin Fan’s body.

Xia Xue and Xia Bing panicked. “Lin Fan, are you okay?”

Lin Fan felt the changes in his body and said, “I’m fine.”

He clenched his fists and said, “It’s strange. I seem to have gained a lot of strength.”

“Are you really alright?” Xia Xue and Xia Bing were still a little worried.

The power and might that the golden dragon claw emitted earlier was too powerful and terrifying.

When they saw it suddenly fly into Lin Fan’s body, how could they not be worried?

Lin Fan shook his head. “Don’t worry, I’m fine. Moreover, this golden dragon claw gives me a particularly familiar feeling.”

“Familiar?” Xia Xue and Xia Bing were puzzled.

“Yes, this feeling… It’s as if this dragon claw has always belonged to me,” Lin Fan said.

At this moment, another golden dragon claw flew over.

Although the dragon claw did give him a familiar feeling, Lin Fan did not dare to let it fly into his body.

After all, he did not know if it would bring about some unknown changes.

The power of space could not stop the dragon claw.

He would use the power of time, then!

Lin Fan used all of his time power to stop the golden dragon claw.

Generally speaking, under the effect of such a powerful time force, it was impossible for anything to survive.

Everything in the surroundings would be fixed and unable to move.

However…

The golden dragon claw was not affected at all.

No, that was not accurate.

Its speed had suddenly increased.

It felt like the golden dragon claw had absorbed the power of time.

Lin Fan’s heart skipped a beat.

“What?”

The golden dragon claw sank into Lin Fan’s body once more.

“Lin Fan…” Xia Xue and Xia Bing said anxiously.

Lin Fan did not reply. Instead, he muttered to himself, “So that’s how it is…”

At this moment, another golden dragon claw flew over.

This time, Lin Fan did not choose to dodge or resist.

Instead, he allowed it to enter his body.

Instantly, Lin Fan’s arm shone with a dazzling golden light.

Upon closer inspection, he discovered that they were actually golden scales.

Lin Fan said, “As expected, the fourth claw!”

As soon as he finished speaking, another dragon claw flew over.

“The fifth claw!”

After the fifth dragon claw entered Lin Fan’s body, golden scales started to appear on his limbs.

“Torso!

“Head!”

The body and the head of a dragon flew over together and quickly entered Lin Fan’s body.

In an instant, an extremely powerful aura erupted, forming a violent hurricane in the spatial passageway.

At the same time, Lin Fan’s body was covered in golden scales that were emitting an incomparably dazzling golden radiance.

From afar, he looked like a golden sun.

He was so dazzling.

A dragon’s roar suddenly sounded in the void. The space shook violently and shook continuously.

Xia Xue and Xia Bing looked up. Their beautiful eyes were full of surprise and worry.

“Lin Fan…”

At this moment, a loud and clear voice suddenly sounded in the endless sky.

“Chaos Dragon God, I didn’t expect you to succeed.”

Then, a huge red shadow whose face could not be seen clearly appeared in the distance.

“A short thousand years. Unbelievable.”

Another loud burst of time rippled back and forth.

A huge green shadow slowly appeared.

“I’ve thought of many possibilities, but I never thought that the Chaos Dragon God would succeed,” a huge blue shadow said.

“This is too surprising,” the enormous gray shadow said.

“It’s so unexpected that I don’t know what to say.”The huge purple figure whose face could not be seen said.

Instantly, the entire space was filled with red, green, blue, gray, purple, and gold. It was a colorful sight that contained a unique beauty.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s figure slowly emerged from the boundless golden light.

At this moment, his entire body was covered in golden scales, as if he was wearing a set of golden armor. It was very strange.

Lin Fan first gave Xia Xue and Xia Bing a reassuring look and said, “Don’t worry, I’m fine.”

After Xia Xue and Xia Bing heard Lin Fan’s voice, they both heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, Lin Fan raised his head and looked at the red, green, blue, gray, and purple figures in front of him. “But I succeeded.”

“Yeah, it worked! This meant that there might still be hope for this world.” The huge red figure said, “In that case, let’s do as we said back then and give him our power.”

“Black, you come out too.”

As soon as he finished speaking, an extremely cold aura spread over.

This feeling… It was as if it wanted to completely freeze a person’s flesh and blood, even their soul.

“Give it to him? Why?!”

An earth-shattering sound reverberated through the heavens and earth.

“The Chaos Dragon God is just a sleepyhead. He’s greedy for money and playful… He’s just a guy who only knows how to enjoy himself!

“The reason why he was able to succeed this time was entirely due to luck!

“He was lucky this time. Next time, will he be able to help our world survive the crisis?

“Why should I give him my power?

“I don’t believe in him!”

His voice was like a thunderbolt that caused everyone’s ears to buzz. The space was like glass that had been hit hard, and cracks appeared.

Lin Fan was not affected at all. He raised his head slowly and looked straight into the dark void.

“You don’t believe me? Then I’ll make you believe me!”

“Is that so? Keke!” A cold laugh came from the darkness.

A giant pitch-black shadow slowly walked out.

Every step he took was like the beating of a drum. Loud sounds rang out continuously, and they burst out with incomparably strong power, causing the space to collapse crazily.

In the next moment, the endless darkness was like a long spear as it shot toward Lin Fan.

It was sharp and terrifying!

However, Lin Fan did not seem to notice it at all. He just stood there without moving.

When the black spear was only a centimeter away from Lin Fan, it was blocked by the golden light around Lin Fan’s body. A loud sound of metal colliding could be heard.

A tyrannical energy storm shot out, blowing Xia Xue and Xia Bing’s hair and clothes.

They could not help but use their hands to block it.
